g.title: Curie
g.desc: Happiest birthday, Jazzie! Thank you for being there for me when I'm really down. You're such a gem & we're so lucky to have you around. I'll be forever indebted to you for your kindness and love that you shared with me. Thank you & may you have the best birthday, ever! 🩷
